data: Which of the following certainty cue (CRT) related values are higher in resolving tweets than non-resolving tweets in verified claims?

The question asks which CRT-related values are higher in resolving tweets than non-resolving tweets in verified claims. From the caption, we know that in verified claims, resolving tweets show higher CRT-related values than non-resolving tweets. The relevant CRT-related values are those associated with the CRT box plots. 

Looking at the CRT box plots in the figure, we can see that the upper quartile (the top of the box) is higher for the 'True' (verified) category compared to the 'False' (falsified) category. This indicates that the CRT-related values are higher in resolving tweets than non-resolving tweets in verified claims.

Therefore, the answer is the upper quartile of the CRT box plot for the 'True' category.
